Great Family experience
Sep 2026 • Family
We did this cooking class today with our three girls and it was a highlight of our Hanoi trip. The market walk at the start was very informative and interesting; our guide explained the herbs, vegetables and ingredients used in Vietnamese cooking, and the kids loved seeing and tasting new things.
The cooking session itself was perfect for families. The instructors were patient and friendly, and all three girls had a great time helping to prepare several dishes. There was plenty of food at the end – more than enough for everyone – and it was lovely to enjoy the meal together.
The old-style building where the class was held was really impressive, with beautiful traditional architecture and a warm atmosphere. A special mention to our guide, Trang, who was outstanding: knowledgeable, engaging and fantastic with the children.
Highly recommended for families in Hanoi who enjoy food and want a fun, authentic experience.

Amazing Cooking Class in Hanoi – A Fantastic Experience for Our Group of 27!
Aug 2026 • Family
What an amazing experience at Hanoi Food Culture!

We came as a very large group of 27 people, and everything was perfectly organized. Mai and Trang welcomed us with so much kindness, energy and professionalism, and they made the whole experience easy, fun and enjoyable for everyone.

The cooking class was interactive and very well explained, and the food was absolutely delicious. We had a great time cooking together and discovering more about Vietnamese cuisine.

One of the highlights was definitely the egg coffee class. It was really interesting to learn how this famous Hanoi specialty is made, and of course even better to taste it afterwards!

Organizing an activity for 27 people can be challenging, but Mai and Trang handled everything wonderfully and made us feel very welcome from beginning to end.

A fun, authentic and memorable experience in Hanoi that we would definitely recommend to families, groups of friends and anyone who wants to discover Vietnamese food and culture.

A huge thank you to Mai and Trang for making this such a special moment during our trip!
